The run failed due to schema mismatches and incorrect financial calculations in the output JSON.

Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed on margin calculations (actual -45894.84 vs expected -83406.84). Ensure the output strictly follows the expected schema and verify the logic for annual margin calculations.
